name: Claude Certified Developer – Foundations
itemFormat: Multiple-choice and multiple-response items; each item states how many responses to select
intendedAudience: Technical professionals (AI/ML engineers, technical leads, senior software engineers) with 1-5 years software engineering experience and 6+ months hands-on Claude/LLM experience, proficient in Python and/or TypeScript.

skills.name: Agent Architecture
skills.description: Principles, patterns, and tradeoffs of agent and workflow architecture, including workflow-vs-agent decision criteria, manager/supervisor hierarchies, and the role of subagents.

skills.name: Agent Construction with Claude
skills.description: Methods, tools, and platforms for constructing Claude agents: the Claude Agent SDK, custom agent loops/harnesses, managed deployment models (self-hosted vs Anthropic-hosted), and hooks for deterministic actions.

skills.name: Agent Patterns and Frameworks
skills.description: Common agent design patterns (tool-use loops, sub-agents, memory, context-window management) and agentic frameworks (e.g., Strands, LangGraph, PydanticAI).

skills.name: Understanding Requirements
skills.description: Functional and infrastructure requirements based on business requirements and solution architecture.

skills.name: Systems Life Cycle
skills.description: Systems life cycle management concepts and frameworks used to develop, implement, operate, and maintain IT systems.

skills.name: Claude API Mechanics
skills.description: Claude API behavior: messages, tools, streaming, vision, thinking, caching, third-party vendor access, Messages API data access patterns, batch API use, realtime-vs-batch tradeoffs.

skills.name: Software Engineering Foundations
skills.description: REST APIs, JSON, asynchronous programming, version control, SDLC integration, code review, small- and large-scale refactoring.

skills.name: Claude Application Design
skills.description: How Claude interprets instructions across interfaces (Claude Code, Desktop, claude.ai, API, SDKs), content boundaries, schema design, session hygiene, plugin management.

skills.name: Configuration Management
skills.description: CLAUDE.md files, settings.json, model version pinning, prompt versioning, plugin dependencies.

skills.name: Claude Code Operation
skills.description: Claude Code core components (Rules, Skills, Commands, Agents, Agent Memory), features (session management, slash commands, headless/streaming mode, auto-mode), CLAUDE.md hierarchy, repository initialization, settings.json configuration.

skills.name: Debugging and Error Handling
skills.description: Error type identification, recovery strategy selection, trace analysis to identify failure modes, problem origin isolation between integration layer and model output.

skills.name: LLM Fundamentals
skills.description: Tokens, context windows, sampling, non-determinism, next-token generation; model options (fast mode, extended/adaptive thinking, effort levels); zero-shot/single-shot/multi-shot prompting.

skills.name: Technical Fundamentals
skills.description: Foundational engineering practices: integrating with SDKs that wrap REST APIs, websockets.

skills.name: Model Selection and Tradeoffs
skills.description: Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku use cases, adaptive thinking support, quality/latency/cost tradeoffs, breaking changes across model releases.

skills.name: Cost and Token Management
skills.description: Token usage tracking, cost modeling, caching techniques (prompt caching, cache check-pointing).

skills.name: Context Engineering
skills.description: Context window management, prevention of context drift/bloat (tool output pruning, compaction), context isolation via subagents/multi-step workflows.

skills.name: Prompt Engineering
skills.description: Instruction clarity, few-shot examples, system vs user placement, output constraints, prompt placement across components, iterative refinement, input sanitization.

skills.name: Output Handling
skills.description: Structured output patterns, response validation, defensive parsing, skepticism toward confident output.

skills.name: AI Application Security
skills.description: Prompt injection awareness/mitigation, jailbreak defense, untrusted input handling, data leakage prevention, PII handling, authN/authZ/confidentiality/privacy/integrity.

skills.name: Guardrails and Safe Deployment
skills.description: Content policy, guardrail layering, secure-by-design principles (privacy, IAM, least privilege).

skills.name: Claude Hooks
skills.description: Leveraging hooks for guardrails and safety controls to prevent destructive actions.

skills.name: Identity, Secrets, and Key Management
skills.description: Managing secrets/credentials/API keys, identity validation and authentication, access approval and monitoring.

skills.name: Tool Implementation
skills.description: Tool use/function calling, configuration for external system interaction, tool description writing, error handling, usage patterns (agentic harness dispatch, client- vs server-side tools, approval patterns).

skills.name: MCP Server Development
skills.description: Server authoring, deployment, integration with Claude applications, MCP resources/tools/prompts, communication patterns (stdio, sockets, client vs server).

skills.name: Agentic Customization
skills.description: Tradeoffs among built-in Tools, custom Tools, Skills, and MCPs.
